chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Abu Muhammad Al-Zuhli, from Abu Ayoub Al-Madaini, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Ibn Bukayr, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The soul, when it secures its sustenance, settles (in peace).'
ai.seo_question: What is the effect of securing one's sustenance on the soul according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the link between material sufficiency and spiritual tranquility, reflecting the Shia emphasis on removing worldly anxieties to facilitate devotion. It underscores that securing one's basic sustenance (qut) is not merely an economic necessity but a prerequisite for the soul's (nafs) stability and readiness for higher spiritual states.
